concerns.text: T009 verifies `python code/pipeline.py --full`, but quickstart.md and plan.md document `--full-batch` (and `code/main.py --full-batch`). The implementer cannot know which CLI flag to build; the verified command and the documented command differ. Pick one flag and align T009, quickstart, and plan.

T002 specifies '~150 molecules' simulation boxes while plan.md Phase 1 and research.md specify '≈300 molecules per solvent'. The system size directly parameterizes build_system.py and the Yeh–Hummer correction (L), so the implementer gets contradictory inputs. State one number in T002.

T005 requires 27 trajectories (3×3×3) but plan.md's own per-seed estimates (1h/2h/3h per 1/5/10 ns seed) sum to ~54 h, far exceeding the stated ≤5.5 h total and the 6 h CI budget. As written, T005/T009 cannot complete on the target runner; the plan's feasibility arithmetic is the root cause and must be resolved (fewer seeds, shorter durations, or a revised budget) before T005 is executable as specified.

T006 says 'compute the variance percentage across seeds' but never names the quantity whose variance is measured (D_corr? MAE? per-seed diffusion estimates?) nor the formula (CV = std/mean × 100?). The sensitivity_report contract only says 'variance percentage across seeds'. Without naming the underlying statistic, two implementers produce different, non-comparable reports.

T007 mandates a paired-bootstrap hypothesis test yielding a numeric p_value, while research.md §4 replaces it with a 'descriptive paired-comparison … without fabricating a formal p-value'. T007 itself is executable, but the contradiction means the implementer cannot tell which procedure satisfies SC-005; align research.md (or the task) to one procedure.
